basis: Frozen published report features + local_readonly_export outcome bars. No rescreen, external quotes or production writes.
cannot_claim_untouched_test: These historical dates were already inspected in prior turns. Chronological subperiods are stability checks, not a pristine holdout.
secondary: next-day close / next-day open - 1 >= 3%; report separately, NOT same-day realized trading profit
risk: next-day close / next-day open - 1 <= -5%; next-day open to T+2/T+3 close
capacity: at most 5 ranked names each signal date; preserve empty slots and missing outcome rows, do not refill
ranking: known signal-day change_pct descending, instrument_id stable tie break, except B0 original highlights rank

conditions.B1: all published candidates signal-day change_pct descending first 5
conditions.B2: within original highlights, signal-day change_pct descending first 5
conditions.C1_solid_volume: change_pct>=4 AND close_position_in_day>=0.75 AND original volume_ratio in [1.5,4]
conditions.C2_not_extended: C1 AND documented distance to MA20<=15
conditions.C3_sector: change_pct>=4 AND close_position_in_day>=0.75 AND same sector >=2 distinct documented same-day limit-up names
conditions.C5_trend_health: change_pct>=4 AND frozen alignment in {bullish,repairing} AND fomo in {low,medium}

open_filter_sensitivity: freeze B2 and C1 lists the night before; next opening gap in [-2,3] only; no refill; availability at opening needs causal execution validation
no_threshold_tuning: All new parameter numbers fixed here; no scan for an optimal threshold. Report ALL tested variants.
implementation_correction: B0/B1/B2 tie break uses instrument_id exactly as v2; earlier preliminary code-sorted figures are NOT final results. New C methods also use instrument_id for consistency.
